# huginhelm Godot 4 starter kits

> Godot 4 (4.7) game starter kits / project templates in typed GDScript: factory & automation, survival crafting, tower defense, 3D real-time strategy (RTS), 2D destruction. Each kit has a free MIT "Lite" edition on GitHub and a paid "Pro" edition (commercial per-seat EULA, prices in EUR) on itch.io. All kits run headless tests via `bash tools/run_tests.sh`.

Each Lite repo contains AGENTS.md and llms.txt describing structure and extension points. Pro keeps the same API as Lite, so projects upgrade without code changes.

## Kits

- [Factory Core – Godot 4 factory / automation starter kit](https://openclawaimac.github.io/factory-core/): Lite (free, MIT, https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-factory-core-lite): Deterministic, headless belt + machine simulation: two-lane belts with side-loading and backpressure, Mk1 recipe machines, round-robin splitter, fair merger, JSON/.tres content, stats and save/load. 65 tests. Pro (€16.00, https://huginhelm.itch.io/factory-core): Godot 4.7 factory kit: belts with lanes & tunnels, machines, splitters, power grid, bottleneck view, build mode, undo and save. 249 tests.
- [Godot Survival Core – Godot 4 survival crafting starter kit](https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-survival-core/): Lite (free, MIT, https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-survival-core-lite): Hunger/thirst needs, day/night clock, slot inventory, data-driven hand crafting and gatherables as pure-logic, headless-testable systems. 48 tests. Pro (€12.00, https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-survival-core): Godot 4.7 survival starter: hunger/thirst, gathering, slot inventory, crafting stations, grid building, chests, day/night, versioned saves. 144 tests.
- [Godot Tower Defense Core – Godot 4 tower defense starter kit](https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-tower-defense-core/): Lite (free, MIT, https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-tower-defense-core-lite): The full TD logic: JSON towers/enemies/waves/map, 4 targeting modes, splash, slow, flyers, armor, upgrades and a 3-wave demo. 54 tests. Pro (€6.00, https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-tower-defense-core): Godot 4.7 tower defense kit: grid placement, 4 targeting modes, splash/slow, flyers, armor, upgrades, data-driven waves, playable demo. 128 tests.
- [Godot RTS Advanced – Godot 4 3D real-time strategy (RTS) starter kit](https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-rts-advanced/): Lite (free, MIT, https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-rts-advanced-lite): The RTS control layer: box selection, control groups, orders, formations, grid A*, production queue, capturable income points, camera, key rebinding and en/fr localization, with a primitive-shape demo. 114 tests. Pro (€19.00, https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-rts-advanced): Godot 4.7 3D RTS kit: selection, formations, cliff-aware pathfinding, cover, fog of war, building, harvesting, AI opponent, save/load. 356 tests.
- [Godot Destruction Core – Godot 4 2D destruction kit](https://openclawaimac.github.io/godot-destruction-core/): Lite (free, MIT, https://github.com/openclawaimac/godot-destruction-core-lite): Destructible cell terrain, damage shapes, single detonations and deterministic structural collapse with falling pieces, rubble and crush damage, plus a two-player demo. 82 tests. Pro (€16.00, https://huginhelm.itch.io/godot-destruction-core): Adds chain reactions, deterministic fire, load-based stress, image/mask import, debug overlays, command log/replay and the Fire Sale demo. 142 tests.
